## Confirmed (11)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device.bout_need` | `8` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: a bout is established when 8 of 10 minutes are at or above the cutpoint |  |
| `device.bout_stop_below` | `3` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: the bout stops when 3 minutes in the 10-minute window are below the cutpoint |  |
| `device.bout_window` | `10` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: MV bout rolling window of 10 minutes |  |
| `device.interrupt_ceiling` | `100` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: interruptions have counts < 100 |  |
| `device.interrupt_minutes` | `2` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: interruptions of up to 2 consecutive minutes |  |
| `device.light_floor` | `100` | Troiano 2008 light intensity 100-2019 counts/min, as in the release |  |
| `device.max_valid_days` | `7` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: only the first 7 valid days are used |  |
| `device.min_valid_days` | `4` | Accelerometry_Descrip.pdf: 4-7 valid days |  |
| `device.mv_cutpoint` | `2020` | Troiano 2008 cutpoint, as in the release |  |
| `device.nonwear_minutes` | `90` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf (non-wear >90 zero minutes); >= 90 within each calendar day reproduces the release's by-day files | Validated for knee-OA wear patterns; 60 is the NHANES rule |
| `device.valid_day_hours` | `10.0` | AccelData_Descrip.pdf: valid day = >= 10 wear hours |  |
